decision: Design Docker now; implement packaging in M2 once UI/API skeleton and tested lockfile exist.
initial_target: One shared AWS EC2 host with Docker Compose, independently configured demo and production projects.
availability: Single host and Availability Zone for application; no high-availability guarantee.

versions.host_os: Ubuntu Server 24.04 LTS x86_64; exact patched AMI/build recorded before provisioning
versions.base_image: Resolve tag and pin tested digest during M2
versions.reverse_proxy: NGINX image tag/digest to be selected and pinned during M2
versions.verification: Release existence checked; joint runtime and host compatibility not tested.

backend_ingress: ALB security group only; no direct app/DB/Docker/SSH internet access
identity: Verify signed ALB identity/signer/expiry; propagate per-request verified identity to API; enforce organization/session authorization.

state.sqlite: Encrypted EBS, one API owner per environment
state.qdrant_local: Encrypted EBS, one API owner per environment
state.receipts: Private encrypted S3, tenant-scoped receipt-store adapter
state.backup: Application-consistent DB backups, policy manifest, encrypted snapshots; measured restore

secrets: Instance profile with temporary AWS credentials, Secrets Manager and scoped delivery; never images/source/build arguments
environment_isolation: Separate Compose project/network/data/credentials/LangSmith destination; one shared host still shares failure/IAM boundary.
release: Test image, private ECR immutable digest, demo smoke, production promotion of same digest; drain single writer and maintain compatible rollback
later_scale: ECS plus external checkpoints/PostgreSQL, server vector storage and shared rate limiting before replicas
fictional_policy_limit: Real-company production needs approved real policy; fictional-only deployment remains labeled capstone/demo.
